summary: Build modern project management skills across agile, product, OKRs, and adaptive governance. Practise roadmaps, dashboards, and AI-assisted risk workflows.
lede: Modern project management combines adaptive planning and product thinking with portfolio governance to keep delivery focused on outcomes. Designed for PMO heads, senior project managers, program managers, product owners, and portfolio managers, this course addresses how to guide work through changing priorities while maintaining visibility and control. Participants practise rolling-wave roadmaps, outcome-linked prioritization, AI-assisted risk reviews, and portfolio dashboards to support evidence-based decisions.
audienceIntro: Modern project management training is designed for leaders and practitioners who must connect adaptive delivery with portfolio control, measurable outcomes, and executive decision-making.
modules: Portfolio Reporting and Power BI Dashboards
prerequisites: You should have practical experience managing projects, programs, products, PMO processes, or portfolio decisions. Familiarity with agile delivery, project lifecycles, or strategic planning is useful but formal certification is not required. No coding or programming is required. Microsoft Excel familiarity supports the exercises, and Microsoft Power BI exposure is helpful but not essential because dashboard work uses guided templates.
